newsitem.title: USA: Illinois postpones restart of 930 MW Clinton nuke.
newsitem.headline: Illinois postpones restart of 930 MW Clinton nuke.

text.p: Illinois Power Co said it has postponed a restart of the 930 megawatt Clinton nuclear power unit until the second half of July from an original restart expectation of July 15.
"We are looking at the second half of July now, likely the week of July 20 to 26 to begin the restart process," company spokesman John Dewey said Thursday.
The unit, located in Clinton, Ill., was shut in early September, 1996 for refueling and maintenance.

The restart delay was needed to permit several maintenance proceedures, Dewey said, adding the company is considering a "stand down" time at the plant to review operations between the end of maintenance and the beginning of a restart.
Illinois Power is a subsidiary of Illinova Corp.
